relevance_note: The paper describes one cohort patient whose de novo deletion includes TNFAIP3 ("The TNFAIP3 gene was involved in the deleted fragment in P6") and summarises a previously published patient with a 6q23.2-q24.3 deletion in the TNFAIP3 context (ref [18]).
method_note: Hand extraction; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and the 20-item checklists. Scope: of 145 cohort patients and 8 with chromosomal abnormalities (P1-P8), only P6 (6q23.3-q24.1 deletion including TNFAIP3) is in scope; P1-P5, P7, P8 and the other literature patients in Table 3 have no TNFAIP3 variant stated and get no rows. Table 3 row 1 (6q23.2-q24.3 del, ref [18]) is included because the Discussion places it in the TNFAIP3 paragraph and ref [18]'s title in the reference list reads 'TNFAIP3 haploinsufficiency is the cause of autoinflammatory manifestations in a patient with a deletion of 13Mb on chromosome 6'; the paper's own text does not state explicitly that this patient's deletion contains TNFAIP3 (uncertain scope). Table 3 has no label column, so the label is 'Table 3 row 1'. Tables 1 and 2 have patients as columns (header row '| Patient | P1 | ... | P8 |'); spans quote the row from its label through the P6 cell. Table symbols: the legends define neither '–' nor '+', so '–' cells are treated as not reported (no excluded rows from '–'); '+' read as present. Pharyngitis/tonsillitis excluded for P6 from the named-group statement '4/6 patients (P1-P4)' among the six named P1-P6. Cytopenia (autoimmune) left not reported for P6: pancytopenia is attributed to suspected HLH, not to autoimmunity. Age at last evaluation for P6 left not reported (Table 2 'Age 51 m' is age at laboratory testing; she died at 4.5 years). n_patients_reported left null: the authors give no count of TNFAIP3 patients. Inheritance de novo for P6 from 'we identified de novo CNVs ... in P6' with trio-WES and 'Their parents had no FUO, and no chromosomal abnormalities were detected'. Age at diagnosis (Table 1, 45 m) differs from the age at which s-JIA was suspected (3.6 years) in the text; table value used. No stacked cells.
